title: ECOGEO 'Omics Training: 3.2 Amplicon Analysis - QIIME
author: Melissa Dsouza
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.fjbbkin

steps.title: Validate mapping file
steps.instruction: Run QIIME's validate_mapping_file.py with the mapping file to check format and write output to mapping_file_output.

steps.title: Join paired‑end reads
steps.instruction: Combine forward, reverse, and barcode FASTQ files into joined reads using QIIME's join_paired_ends.py and write results to the directory “reads”.

steps.title: Demultiplex and quality filter
steps.instruction: Demultiplex the joined FASTQ file, apply a quality filter of Q≥29, specify barcode length 12, and store demultiplexed FASTQ files using split_libraries_fastq.py.

steps.title: De novo OTU picking
steps.instruction: Perform de novo OTU clustering on the quality‑filtered sequences with pick_de_novo_otus.py, outputting results to the uclust_otus directory.

steps.title: Closed‑reference OTU picking
steps.instruction: Cluster sequences against the Greengenes 13_8 97% reference set using pick_closed_reference_otus.py, providing the reference fasta and taxonomy files, and write reference OTUs.

steps.title: Open‑reference OTU picking
steps.instruction: Run open‑reference OTU clustering with pick_open_reference_otus.py using the same Greengenes reference fasta, outputting to uclust_open_otu.

steps.title: Summarize and annotate BIOM tables
steps.instruction: Generate summary statistics, add sample and observation metadata, and convert the BIOM OTU table to a tab‑delimited text file.

substeps.instruction: biom add-metadata -i $PWD/otu_table_even10.biom -o denovo_otu.biom --sample-metadata-fp map_file.txt --observation-metadata-fp $PWD/uclust_assigned_taxonomy/subs_seqs_q_rep_set_tax_assignments.txt --observation-header OTUID,taxonomy --sc-separated taxonomy

steps.title: Identify chimeric sequences
steps.instruction: Detect chimeric sequences in the representative set alignment using ChimeraSlayer and write the list to chimeric_seqs.txt.

steps.title: Core diversity analysis
steps.instruction: Run QIIME's core_diversity_analyses.py on the de novo OTU BIOM table with a rarefaction depth of 10, using the mapping file and reference tree.
